tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files used by Crack.

cracklib.description: Directory for Crack dictionaries and supporting data.

default_fmt.description: Default input format for password files; 'spf' is shadow password file (Debian default).

notify_users.description: List of usernames to notify via email when their password is cracked.

nastygram_path.description: Path to the 'nastygram' script used for sending email warnings.

nice.description: Nice level (priority adjustment) for Crack process.

max_rules.description: Maximum number of rules to process per pass; 0 means no limit.

foreground.description: Run Crack in foreground mode (attaches stdin/stdout/stderr to console).

password_files.description: List of password files to process (e.g., /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow).

mail_enabled.description: Enable sending email warnings to affected users when their passwords are cracked.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug output for Crack script.

keep_tmp.description: Preserve temporary input file after cracking completes.

recover.description: Enable recover mode to resume an abnormally terminated run.

start_rule.description: Start cracking from this rule number; 0 means start from first rule.

network_mode.description: Run Crack in network mode (distributed cracking).

reporter_quiet.description: Suppress error reporting (e.g., corrupt entries) in Crack-Reporter.
